changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.09[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]New context menu[/COLOR]
-Long-press or the context key shows a luc_kodi entry that opens the plugin's own panel on the right of the screen, with the same look in every skin and on every device.
-The panel shows the poster (or the icon of a menu, whole), title, year, runtime, rating, watched and resume progress, and the list and page you are in.
-Every option of the item is there, with the logo of its service: Trakt, SIMKL, MDBList, WeTrakr, PunchPlay, the debrid services and YouTube for trailers. It works in movies, TV shows, seasons, episodes, menus, collections, Premiere Lists, the debrid clouds, home screen widgets and the Bingie windows.
-Movies and episodes have Play at the top: it plays the title exactly as clicking it does.
-New Information view inside the panel for movies, TV shows, seasons and episodes: air date, number of episodes, rating, genres and overview. Seasons get their own information from TMDb, which Kodi's own Information entry does not open for an add-on.
-Seasons have Play Trailer: the trailer of that season, or the show's trailer when the season has none.
-Kodi's own menu only keeps the luc_kodi entry and Exit. Settings > Navigation > Context menu brings back the classic menu if you prefer it.
[COLOR fffdb515]Back, Exit and Home[/COLOR]
-Three ways out under the panel title: Back goes one step back, Exit leaves the whole subcategory, and Home goes to the luc_kodi main menu.
-Exit is named after where you are. In a list, Exit Trending - Trakt takes you back to the menu you opened it from, instead of pressing Back once for every page (suggested by a user on Xbox). In a show's seasons and episodes, Exit Ted Lasso takes you back to the page of the list the show was on, keeping Kodi's history as it was.
-Kodi's own menu shows the same Exit entry. It can be turned off in Settings > Navigation > Context menu.
[COLOR fffdb515]Search luc_kodi[/COLOR]
-New search inside the plugin, opened from the round search button at the top of the context panel. It looks for menus, categories, subcategories, settings and actions, not for titles: typing "search" takes you to the plugin's Search menus.
-Menus come from the real menus, so it shows what you have switched on in Settings > Navigation and the services you have connected. Every language of Languages is there with its flag, and is also found by its own name or its Spanish name (Romana, Rumano, Turkce, Turco...), with or without accents.
-On/off and list settings change right in the results with OK or Left/Right and show their current value. Text settings never show what they hold. Any other setting opens the plugin settings on its category, and the search comes back with the same words when you close them.
-Results show where they live (Navigation >> Movies, Accounts >> TorBox) and the logo of their service. An empty search shows your recent picks and the main menu.
[COLOR fffdb515]PunchPlay Manager[/COLOR]
-New in the context menu of movies, TV shows and episodes when PunchPlay is authorized, like the Trakt and WeTrakr managers: mark as watched or unwatched, Watchlist, Favourites, rate from 1 to 10, and add to or remove from your own lists.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-AIOStreams sources now read the language lines and flags of their description, like Comet, MediaFusion and Torrentio. Their audio languages came only from the release name and the audio probe.
-Two lines of the English language file were malformed. Because of them, Kodi could leave empty the "Default Play Next Action in..." countdown of the Play Next window.
-On a fresh install, marking a title as watched could fail when the add-on data folder did not exist yet. The watched database now creates it, like the other databases do.
